subject: Change the colour of distinct bins in a histogram

messages.author: a321e6ab7b0cca0d
messages.subject: Change the colour of distinct bins in a histogram
parts:
Dear list,

I would like to mark distinct values (bins) in a histogram.
My DF looks like this:

library(ggplot2)
set.seed(123)
df <- data.frame( value = sort(runif(20)),
ck = rep(c("FALSE", "TRUE", "FALSE"), c(2, 15, 3)))
df
#> df
# value ck
#1 0.04205953 FALSE
#2 0.04555650 FALSE
#3 0.10292468 TRUE
#4 0.24608773 TRUE
#5 0.28757752 TRUE
#6 0.32792072 TRUE
#7 0.40897692 TRUE
#8 0.45333416 TRUE
#9 0.45661474 TRUE
#10 0.52810549 TRUE
#11 0.55143501 TRUE
#12 0.57263340 TRUE
#13 0.67757064 TRUE
#14 0.78830514 TRUE
#15 0.88301740 TRUE
#16 0.89241904 TRUE
#17 0.89982497 TRUE
#18 0.94046728 FALSE
#19 0.95450365 FALSE
#20 0.95683335 FALSE

# Make a histogram
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = value) )
p <- p + geom_histogram(colour = "black", fill = "yellow", binwidth =
0.05)
p <- p + scale_x_continuous("vBp", limits=c(0, 1)) + theme_bw()
p

My question now - how can I change the colour of the
bins with values checked as FALSE to "red"?

Thanks for any help!
Patrick

messages.author: 4ddc99c6029ba75d
messages.subject: Re: Change the colour of distinct bins in a histogram
parts:
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(123)
df <- data.frame( value = sort(runif(20)),
ck = rep(c("FALSE", "TRUE", "FALSE"), c(2, 15, 3)))
df

# Make a histogram
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = value,fill=ck)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=0.05,colour="black")
p <- p + scale_x_continuous("vBp",limits=c(0,1))
p <- p + scale_fill_manual(values=c("red","yellow"),name="") + theme_bw()
p

Felipe D. Carrillo
Supervisory Fishery Biologist
Department of the Interior
US Fish & Wildlife Service
California, USA
